g.text: Muscle 1–3%/day, bones thin, clots form, lungs + bowels stall, delirium blooms — MOBILISE
from admission: sit out, stand, walk (aids + supervision), physio day 1, "pyjamas ban" (dress
= mindset). Exercise Rx: strength 2×/wk + balance 3×/wk + walk 150 min/wk + flex daily.
STICK
opposite hand,
elbow 20–30°,
mild unsteadiness
FRAME
lift-step-place,
indoors + level,
weak/very unsteady
WHEELCHAIR
fitted + cushion,
pressure plan,
not a parking bay!
HOME AIDS
rails, raised seat,
commode, ramp,
bed lever, bell
HOME HAZARDS CHECKLIST (visit + fix + re-visit): light (bulbs + night lights + torch)
+ floor (mats OUT, cords taped, spills wiped, level thresholds) + bathroom (rails, non-slip,
raised seat, shower stool) + bed (height, lever, bell, commode near) + stairs (rails BOTH sides,
contrast edges, gate if wandering) + kitchen (stove guard, kettle tipper, gas check for smell-
loss) + outside (path even, handrail, farm-task swap: lighter duties, same dignity).
HIP FRACTURE PATHWAY: suspect (fall + hip/groin pain + short rotated leg — don't walk!) →
X-ray → analgesia + fluids + delirium watch → surgery FAST (<48 h saves lives) → mobilise
DAY 1 post-op → physio + OT + nutrition + bone protection (calcium/D + osteoporosis Rx) →
home rehab + falls plan (M02 workup). 1-year mortality ~30% — speed + mobilisation decide.
REHAB GOALS (elder-set, M01): "walk to farm gate / mosque / market stall" — SMART + dated +
team (nurse + physio + OT + family + elder) + reviewed. OT: dressing gadgets, kitchen
adaptations, energy-saving (sit to cook, pace tasks). Contractures prevented (position +
passive moves), Foot drop splinted, pressure plan rides along (M02). Celebrate metres:
"bed-to-door Monday, gate Friday" — progress posted where the elder SEES it.
Discharge: aids fitted + home visited + family trained (teach-back) + follow-up dated +
CHPS linked — rehabilitation continues at home or it evaporates.
